out: building   loopline, a file server for producers
learning   linux, bash, k3s, ci/cd pipelines

projects.name: Loopline
projects.tagline: A self-hosted file server built around a producer's workflow.
projects.description: Tagged folders, BPM and key detection from filenames, in-browser waveform previews, a real playback queue and password-protected share links.

projects.name: Artspecifikationer
projects.tagline: Animals documented like hardware spec sheets.
projects.description: A field guide in Swedish where every species gets a technical data sheet instead of an encyclopedia entry. One component per species card.

projects.name: isak-sandbox
projects.tagline: A single-node K3s box for breaking things safely.
projects.description: Ansible-provisioned and ArgoCD-managed. New home-lab ideas get tried here before they touch the real cluster.

projects.name: Formcraft
projects.tagline: A low-code visual form builder living in one React file.
projects.description: Drag elements onto a canvas, shape them in the inspector, then export schema JSON or a production-ready React + Tailwind component.
